* A {@code ClassLoader} implementation that implements a delegate last lookup policy. * For every class or resource this loader is requested to load, the following lookup order * is employed: * *
    *
  • The boot classpath is always searched first
    • *
  • Then, the list of {@code dex} files associated with this classloaders's * {@code dexPath} is searched.
    • *
  • Finally, this classloader will delegate to the specified {@code parent}.
    • *

variables.name: delegateResourceLoading
variables.comment: * Whether resource loading delegates to the parent class loader. True by default.
